description: Create a Jack from an owned Story using the saved voice and output controls, then save it as a draft Post in the library. Returns the Jack text and the new Post id, which schedule_post and export_to_tap accept as content_id. Uses one generation from the daily allowance. Use generate_post_dry_run instead only when you want the text without a library entry; it costs the same allowance.

notes.description: The writer's own material for this post: their view, a voice-memo transcript or their own figures. The post is built around it.

story_id.description: The story ID to base the generation on.

name: generate_post
